stress_expectations.question: What was verified pump uptime in 2024?
stress_expectations.expected_behavior: Exact visible-page highlight only after rotation transform is verified; otherwise page-only fallback.
stress_expectations.review_note: Rotated PDF bbox requires viewer-coordinate check.

stress_expectations.question: What is visible service coverage in 2024?
stress_expectations.expected_answer: 71 percent; the 99 percent decoy lies outside the visible CropBox.
stress_expectations.expected_behavior: Use visible cropped page coordinates; never cite or answer from the outside-crop decoy.
stress_expectations.review_note: Review with viewer honoring CropBox; default pdftoppm rendering may show MediaBox.

stress_expectations.question: What action follows the north-pump finding?
stress_expectations.expected_answer: Replace the seal before 30 June 2024, then verify pressure at 12 bar.
stress_expectations.expected_behavior: Read left finding then right action; keep sidebar separate from observed results.

stress_expectations.question: What were North and West delivered volumes in 2024?
stress_expectations.expected_answer: North: 12.4 million m3; West: 3.5 million m3.
stress_expectations.expected_behavior: Join the continued table across pages while preserving each cell's page and region.

stress_expectations.question: What valve-integrity value is shown?
stress_expectations.expected_answer: The visible page appears to show 63 percent, but extraction should warn or withhold if OCR confidence is inadequate.
stress_expectations.expected_behavior: Do not fabricate an exact span or high-support factual answer; page-only fallback or explicit uncertainty is acceptable.

stress_expectations.question: What was the audited 2024 leakage estimate?
stress_expectations.expected_answer: 17.9 percent; the earlier 18.4 percent was a draft superseded by the audit.
stress_expectations.expected_behavior: Cite both draft and audited pages when explaining the conflict; do not silently select the draft.
